experiment: WAM granularity controls with compact equal-area random regions
random_control: A deterministic, contiguous, near-square region with exactly the same foreground-pixel count as the image-specific SAM mask, placed uniformly among all fitting top-left locations without wraparound.
design_note: All marked conditions share the same image-specific 32-bit message and the same WAM candidate perturbation. Only spatial support or full-frame perturbation scale changes.
